question: In ∆EFG, XY ∥ FG, area of the quadrilateral XFGY = 44 m2. If EX : XF = 2 : 3, then find the area of ∆EXY (in m2).
solution:
**Given:**

In ∆EFG, XY ∥ FG, area of the quadrilateral XFGY = 44 m².

EX : XF = 2 : 3

**Formula Used:**

Area of ∆EXY = (EX/EF)² × Area of ∆EFG

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6bf315cecb9d76a639a05133c3e959cdb819fdb3a254644e4726280aaf3b589.png] 

Let EF = EX + XF

Let EX = 2k and XF = 3k

Then, EF = 2k + 3k = 5k

Ratio of EX to EF = EX/EF = 2k/5k = 2/5

Since XY ∥ FG, ∆EXY ~ ∆EFG (similar triangles)

Area of ∆EFG = Area of ∆EXY + Area of quadrilateral XFGY

Area of ∆EFG = Area of ∆EXY + 44

Ratio of areas of similar triangles = (Ratio of corresponding sides)²

Therefore, (Area of ∆EXY) / (Area of ∆EFG) = (EX/EF)²

(Area of ∆EXY) / (Area of ∆EFG) = (2/5)²

(Area of ∆EXY) / (Area of ∆EFG) = 4/25

Let Area of ∆EFG = A

Then, Area of ∆EXY = (4/25) × A

A = (4/25) × A + 44

⇒ A - (4/25) × A = 44

⇒ (21/25) × A = 44

⇒ A = 44 × (25/21)

⇒ A = 52.38

Area of ∆EXY = (4/25) × 52.38

⇒ Area of ∆EXY = 8.38 m²

**The area of ∆EXY is 8.38 m².**
